name: converge-loop
description: Run multi-agent deliberation loops that debate, negotiate, and converge on stronger plans.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent debate and convergence for plans and decisions
interface.longDescription: Use converge-loop to orchestrate constructive back-and-forth between agents, gather evidence, surface pushback, and converge on a stronger plan or a clear unresolved decision point.
defaultPrompt: Use converge-loop to strengthen this plan
Have two agents debate this decision
Find pushback and better ideas for this artifact
